_comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen-knowledge.ts from the hyperswitch-prism repo. Do not edit by hand.

discrepancies.title: Refund's prerequisites are listed differently in two docs
discrepancies.summary: The flow dependency graph says Refund requires Authorize AND Capture; a table in the add-connector-flow skill lists only Authorize.
discrepancies.resolution: Treat the flow-dependencies.md graph as authoritative: Refund depends on Authorize AND Capture (you can only refund money that was captured). The SKILL.md summary table is abbreviated and omits Capture.

discrepancies.title: The number of connectors differs by source
discrepancies.summary: Different sources report different connector counts because they count different things.

sources.says: 95 `pub mod` connector modules registered on disk
Connectors: 93 (a generated digest that can lag)

discrepancies.resolution: For 'how many connectors are implemented', count the `pub mod` lines in connectors.rs (the on-disk registry). Generated digests (llms.txt) and proto-derived counts can differ because they include or exclude config-only or unregistered entries. This server reads the count live and always labels its source -- it never asserts a bare number.
